title: Add top-level path and preset CLI arguments
body:
Plan: `.pi/plans/2026-09-20-scripted-session/plan.md`

Modify: `src/main.rs`

Add optional top-level `--path <PATH>` and `--preset <NAME>` arguments. Parse path as `PathBuf` with a small Clap value parser that rejects non-absolute values. Declare `--preset` as requiring `--path`. Ensure opening flags conflict with `switch`, `close`, and `refresh` rather than being silently ignored. Dispatch `--path` mode to `grove::open_path`; keep plain `grove` and all existing subcommands unchanged. Config remains authoritative and loads for both opening modes.

Expected shape:
```rust
#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(version, about = "tmux sessions for Git worktrees", args_conflicts_with_subcommands = true)]
struct Cli {
    #[arg(long, value_parser = absolute_path)]
    path: Option<PathBuf>,
    #[arg(long, requires = "path")]
    preset: Option<String>,
    #[command(subcommand)]
    command: Option<Command>,
}
```
The exact Clap annotations may differ if tests demonstrate equivalent behavior; do not add a subcommand or dependency.

Reference: `src/main.rs:4-33` — current Clap structure and dispatch. Reference: `src/main.rs:35-68` — parser-test style using `Cli::try_parse_from`.

Extend parser tests for: absolute path alone; absolute path plus preset; preset without path; relative path; and opening flags mixed with each existing subcommand.

Acceptance: ISC-8 and ISC-9 pass as argument-parse checks; plain/subcommand behavior remains intact; `cargo test --bin grove` passes.

Dependencies: TODO-0002.
